why: Cart.tsx imports formatPrice and the map renders formatPrice(item.price), without the curly braces: inside JSX that is text, so every row shows the words 'formatPrice(item.price)' instead of a price, and the import is never used (tsc's noUnusedLocals in the Vite template flags it, the status bar shows ⊗ 1). The prices do not go through formatPrice.
